items.prompt: Repaint Image1 into sealed limb 3 of the same eldritch god as Image2, a single hooked HAND cutout. Image1 gives side/back three-quarter pose, short forearm from upper left, curling long fingers aimed down/right. Image2 ONLY supplies family anatomy/material/paint: matte charcoal-black organic skin, muted violet planes and concentrated violet joint cracks, severe knuckle ridges, long dark claws, black sealing wrist cuff with one pale diamond, short heavy gray chain. Final hand has four curled fingers plus a distinct opposable thumb, five digits total, clean separation gaps and readable knuckles. Keep Image1 hooked grasp, do not copy Image2 upright open fan. Harmonize skin and cuff with Image2 but retain purposeful broad opaque paint swipes, handmade hard light-shadow edges, sparse structural lines, quiet surfaces, readable anatomy. It is a primordial organic hand, not armor or mechanical gauntlet. Simplify silver reflections, fine grooves and many chain links. Entire object and all fingertips fit inside square with a clear margin. Genuine TRANSPARENT alpha background throughout all empty space and between fingers: no white/black/color backdrop, baked checkerboard, ground or cast shadow. No extra hands/body/head/feet/toes/held object/gore, no glossy metal, texture filter, fine scratch noise, triangular mosaic or oil ridges. No text/frame/UI/watermark.
